description: Single source of truth for which machine contracts each project type must produce. Read by sdd.cjs and referenced by completeness-checklist.md. 'required' artifacts must exist; 'conditional' artifacts must exist OR be listed in specs/contracts/manifest.json#notApplicable with a justification.

game.note: Expose deterministic game logic through a headless 'cli' simulation entry point (seed + input sequence -> state JSON) so the oracle can grade it.

library.note: The oracle reaches a library through a frozen JSON-in/JSON-out adapter in specs/fixtures/adapters/, invoked by 'run' steps.

openapi.describes: HTTP operations, parameters, request/response schemas, declared statuses

errors.describes: Canonical error taxonomy (codes, HTTP status or exit code, retryable)

statecharts.describes: Entity lifecycles: states, transitions, guards, illegal-transition error

cli.describes: Commands, arguments, flags, exit codes, stdout formats (cli tools; a game's headless simulation)

interfaces.http: Graded by oracle.cjs http steps against openapi operations
interfaces.library: Graded by oracle.cjs run steps through a frozen adapter
interfaces.browser: Graded by frozen black-box UI specs in specs/fixtures/ui/ (data-testid selectors only), compared across builds with `oracle.cjs diff-ui`, plus Stage 06 VAT
